description: Echo macOS notch player window — the smallest possible surface. It draws one panel and calls the same typed commands as the main window (`player_control` / `seek` / `set_favorite` / `notch_player_set_expanded`), so it needs the core defaults for event subscription and nothing else: no shell, fs, sql, opener, dialog, process or network permission family, and no window-control permission (the window is positioned and resized by the Rust side, never by the renderer).
